national_news.title: Defence Minister Emphasizes Emerging Warfare Preparedness at Bagdogra IAF Station
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed Indian Air Force (IAF) personnel at Bagdogra Airport in Siliguri, highlighting the strategic significance of the region in securing North-Eastern India.
Stressed the shift in modern warfare toward non-conventional threats, including cyberattacks, drone warfare, proxy wars, and information warfare.
Emphasized indigenous technological development under 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat', focusing on startups developing anti-drone systems and advanced defense equipment.

national_news.title: Petroleum Ministry Confirms E20 Fuel Meets BIS IS 17021 Specifications
bullets: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas rejected claims of excess ethanol content, clarifying that E20 petrol supplied nationwide complies with Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) specification IS 17021.
Testing of 893 samples across 27 States and UTs (including 56 in Karnataka) confirmed ethanol blending levels remained within the prescribed statutory range of 19% to 20%.
Public sector Oil Marketing Companies (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL) maintain established quality assurance systems across distribution networks to ensure standard compliance.

national_news.title: PM Modi Felicitates Record-Breaking Asian Para Games Contingent
bullets: India achieved a historic haul of 114 medals (30 gold, 35 silver, 49 bronze), along with 5 world records and 9 Asian records at the Asian Para Games.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi credited grassroots infrastructure, Khelo India Centres, and the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) for building a modern sporting ecosystem ahead of the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics.
Key milestones included 34 of 56 female athletes winning medals, Mona Agarwal establishing a world record in para shooting, and debutant Sandeep setting a world record.

national_news.title: API Integration Launched Between Startup India and I-STEM Portals
bullets: The Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser (PSA) to the Government of India launched API integration between the Startup India portal and the Indian Science, Technology and Engineering Facilities Map (I-STEM) portal.
Developed in collaboration with DPIIT under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, the initiative connects DPIIT-recognised startups with national research infrastructure.
The integration aims to lower R&D costs for startups, eliminate facility duplication, and streamline access to publicly funded scientific and testing equipment.

national_news.title: IAF Partners with IIT Madras to Develop Indigenous Airborne Communication System
bullets: The Indian Air Force's Software Development Institute signed a Memorandum of Agreement with IIT Madras and IITM Pravartak Technologies Foundation.
The collaboration aims to design and develop an indigenous secure digital communication system and advanced networking algorithms for airborne operations.
The project supports the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative by decreasing dependence on foreign technology and strengthening networked warfare capabilities.

national_news.title: Government Grants 2-Year Extension and Permanent Enrolment Pathway for Agniveers
bullets: Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh announced that Agniveers will be given an additional two-year extension after completing their four-year tenure, enabling full eligibility for regular soldier enrolment.
Introduced in June 2022, the Agnipath recruitment scheme originally recruited youth aged 17.5 to 21 years for four years, with a provision to retain only 25 percent in regular services.
Under the revised policy, serving Agniveers can be absorbed as regular soldiers after six years of total service, subject to willingness, discipline, and physical fitness criteria.

national_news.title: India Retains Men's Asian Hockey Championship Title Defeating Japan 4-1
bullets: India secured the 9th Hero Asian Hockey Championship title for the 6th time by defeating Japan 4-1 at the Olympian Balbir Singh Senior International Hockey Stadium in Mohali.
The tournament marked the final international appearance for Indian midfielder Nilakanta Sharma.
Malaysia won the bronze medal in the championship after defeating South Korea 5-2.

national_news.title: India Targets Over $220 Billion Investment to Reach 500 GW Non-Fossil Capacity by 2030
bullets: Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy Pralhad Joshi announced that renewable energy investments are expected to exceed $220 billion to add 190 GW non-fossil power capacity by 2030.
India's installed non-fossil fuel power capacity currently stands at 310 GW, progressing toward the national goal of 500 GW by 2030.
The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy is formulating new guidelines specifically targeting the recycling of solar module waste.

national_news.title: India Observes International Day for Biosphere Reserves Highlighting 18 Notified Sites
bullets: India features a network of 18 nationally notified Biosphere Reserves, 13 of which are part of UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves.
Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve (established 1986) was India's first biosphere reserve, while Himachal Pradesh's Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve was included in UNESCO's network in 2025.
Biosphere reserves follow a three-tier zoning model comprising Core Areas (~18% globally), Buffer Zones (~30%), and Transition Areas (~52%) to balance conservation with sustainable human development.

national_news.title: Sacred Piprahwa Buddha Relics Exhibited at Tawang Monastery in Arunachal Pradesh
bullets: Over 21,000 devotees visited Gaden Namgyal Lhatse (Tawang Monastery) in Arunachal Pradesh for the sacred exposition of Shakyamuni Buddha relics.
The event was organized by the Ministry of Culture in collaboration with the International Buddhist Confederation (IBC) and the Government of Arunachal Pradesh.
The relics were originally discovered at Piprahwa, Uttar Pradesh in 1898 and are preserved at the National Museum, New Delhi.

national_news.title: India Successfully Tests Indigenous Quasi-Ballistic Missile 'Pralay' Off Odisha Coast
bullets: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully conducted user evaluation trials of the surface-to-surface quasi-ballistic missile 'Pralay' from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha.
Pralay is a solid-propellant missile with a strike range of 150 to 500 km, a payload capacity of 500 to 1,000 kg, and an advanced Inertial Navigation System with RF seeker.
Developed by Research Centre Imarat (RCI), Hyderabad, and produced by Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL), the missile features low-altitude in-flight maneuvers to evade interception.

bihar_news.title: NHAI to Pilot Barrier-Free Toll Collection on NH-31 in Bihar
bullets: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) selected NH-31 in Bihar for an initial trial of a technology-based, barrier-free toll collection system.
The initiative utilizes Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) cameras and GPS-linked vehicle data to implement a 'Pay for the Distance Travelled' tolling model.
Managed by NPCI and NHAI, FASTag was launched as a pilot in 2014 and became mandatory across all Indian toll plazas in 2021.

bihar_news.title: TERI Partners with BSPGCL for Renewable Energy and Storage Solutions in Bihar
bullets: The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Bihar State Power Generation Company Limited (BSPGCL) during the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit 2026.
The MoU focuses on developing energy storage infrastructure (battery and pumped storage) and advanced solar applications including AgriPV, building-integrated, and rail/road-integrated photovoltaics.
TERI also finalized clean energy transition agreements with West Bengal to establish EV charging corridors and AgriPV frameworks.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Enhances Rural Water Tower Solar Panel Capacity to 20 kW
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary directed officials to increase the solar panel capacity on rural water towers under the Chief Minister Gramin Peyjal Nishchay Yojana from 5 kW to 20 kW.
The solarization scheme will be executed by the Bihar Renewable Energy Development Agency (BREDA), which will oversee implementation, monitoring, and maintenance.
Funding for the project and the solarization of Panchayat Sarkar buildings will be linked to allocations from the 15th Finance Commission and the 7th State Finance Commission.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Becomes First State to Launch Comprehensive Silt Management Policy 2026
bullets: Bihar launched the 'Bihar Water Sources Restoration and Silt Management Policy, 2026', becoming the first Indian state to formulate a comprehensive framework for scientific river desilting and flood risk reduction.

Under the 'Nadi Sanjeevani Initiative', an MoU was signed between MoRTH and Bihar to utilize 243 lakh cubic metres of excavated river silt across 16 ongoing National Highway projects, with Bihar RCD as the nodal agency.
The policy provides financial assistance of ₹20,000 per two hectares to farmers for excavating sand and silt deposited on agricultural land.

bihar_news.title: NHAI and Bihar Government Sign MoU to Use River Silt for Highway Construction
bullets: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) and the Bihar government signed an MoU for scientifically desilting water bodies under the initiative 'Nadi Sanjivani, Nadi Punarjeevan, Sadak Navnirman'.
The initiative aims to address silt accumulation, seasonal flooding, and construction material shortages in rivers such as the Ganga, Kosi, Gandak, Falgu, and Bagmati.
Under the agreement, 39.3 million cubic metres of silt will be provided free of cost for ongoing highway projects, with another 105 million cubic metres planned for future projects.
The project draws inspiration from Maharashtra’s 'Buldhana Pattern' of using excavated soil for highway earthwork while deepening water bodies.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Mandates Pre-Serving Tasting and Certification for Midday Meals
bullets: Bihar's Directorate of Mid-Day Meal Scheme directed headmasters and teachers-in-charge of government and aided schools to taste and certify meals before serving.
Designated officials must maintain a signed daily record certifying that the food was tasted, satisfactory, and fit for consumption for verification by District Education Officers.
If senior officials are absent, a nominated teacher must complete the mandatory tasting to ensure uninterrupted daily quality compliance.
